Lakeside Hospital

Lakeside Hospital provides hospital care for patients and families in Metairie as part of the LCMC Health nonprofit system.

Since joining LCMC Health in 2023, the hospital has continued serving local healthcare needs within the region's connected network.
fields.pageSubtitle: Hospital care connected to LCMC Health

fields.Detail:
Lakeview Hospital

Lakeview Hospital has served St. Tammany Parish since 1977 with routine, specialty, and hospital care.

Patients can connect with services that include heart, stroke, and emergency care through the LCMC Health network.

fields.Detail:
New Orleans East Hospital

New Orleans East Hospital physicians and staff care for patients and families in New Orleans East.

The hospital provides community-based services within LCMC Health's connected network of facilities and specialists.

Touro

Touro is a community-based nonprofit hospital with generations of service to New Orleans patients and families.

The hospital combines compassionate local care with the broader specialties and resources of the LCMC Health system.

West Jefferson Medical Center

West Jefferson Medical Center is a Marrero hospital serving Westbank patients and families.

Physicians practice across a broad range of specialties, connecting community-based hospital care with LCMC Health services.
